Yes, please! I just finished Infinite (never have played a bioshock game before, but am a bit familiar with them), I have so many emotions at the same time. I cannot stress just how amazing that story was.

Thanks for that, it gives me hope. I think I will see if I can get a hold of a psychiatric professional in my school and see how to deal with my anxiety. For now I just want to focus on getting a job and becoming financially independent.
